scope: preview-only; current runtime unchanged; real calibration points pending
shared:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity design PREVIEW for the EXISTING Chinese WeChat outdoor cat-and-mouse game, not a new visual identity. Input image 1 is the current expanded MOUSE game screen: preserve its sunny 16-bit pixel art UI, gray pixel mouse face, cyan mouse team bar, warm ivory paper cards, black stepped pixel outlines, orange/cyan accents, pixel Chinese typography. Input image 2 is the current collapsed screen, for the same layout and map emphasis. Input image 3 is the approved Yingzhou/Huanzhou island MAP BACKGROUND: keep this actual island image and its recognizable winding footpaths, bridges, roofs, shoreline and upright orientation; use as the screen background, uniform scale only, never stretch, invent paths, rotate or redraw geography. This is a design edit of the supplied screens, preserve the established feel rather than migrate to a generic modern/glass app.
OUTPUT: one polished landscape comparison image, two large equal-size portrait iPhone mockups side-by-side, identical restrained slim dark bezels, consistent 390:844 content proportions, aligned, with generous but small ivory outside margins. Left phone shows panels expanded, right phone shows the SAME UI with panels retracted; no differences to game state or map zoom/center between the two. The phone screen content must remain big and readable. Optionally a narrow 3-step motion storyboard below the phones, just icon/panel silhouettes and small direction arrows, not paragraphs. It is a still-image motion proposal, not an animation.
CORE REQUEST: eliminate ALL text buttons for opening/closing/collapsing/expanding. No visible words 收起, 展开, 收回, 详情, 更多, 关闭, 操作 on any control. Communicate collapse/expand by icon-only affordances, grip, double chevrons, and the motion sequence. Use coherent pixel-built icons with adequate 44px tap areas. Remove the ugly full-width strips reading 本局状态 and 收起状态 and 收起操作 and 展开操作 entirely. Retain essential Chinese status labels: 猫鼠行动 in the WeChat nav; 鼠队 · 追逐中 in the role panel; 04:45 clock; 1 / 4 capture progress. Keep a small 待标定 label because real control points have not yet been collected. No invented live player or enemy locations, GPS markers, precise enemy pin, radar scan, score store or skills. Main map can be panned/pinched; art fills it with no letterbox bands and no nonuniform scale.
Top expanded HUD retains the current pixel mouse portrait, blue team banner, ivory countdown/progress card. Collapse this into a genuinely small edge affordance while keeping clock and target count readable. Main action remains a recognizable cyan pixel QR icon button, plus small team-list icon and rules-book icon. Secondary recenter uses a crosshair; pause uses two bars. These are simple, consistent icon-only controls, no labels underneath. Do not draw a real or fake dense scannable QR matrix. Avoid emojis, glassmorphism, gradients, glossy 3D, neon, new mascots, random app tabs and additional gameplay. Map must dominate: expanded state map at least 60% unobstructed; collapsed state about 85%. Use measured small pixel drop shadows and warm paper fills. All important typography readable.
